results.relevance: Strongly associated with GPA/PR3-ANCA vasculitis. Homozygous carriage confers highest risk. Confirms disease subtype.
Alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency variants are associated with PR3-ANCA vasculitis. MZ genotype is a known risk factor for GPA.
Associated with GPA susceptibility in European populations.

interpretation: Strong genetic profile for PR3-ANCA GPA. Multiple risk alleles present. Supports clinical diagnosis despite lower-range PR3-ANCA titers.
